name: Alpaca
label: Alpaca — Alpaca Trading API v2 + Market Data
description: Official Alpaca Trading API v2 + Market Data. Docs: https://docs.alpaca.markets. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress. Broker-dealer. PDT rules. Not unlicensed advisory. Paper host is default; live is api.alpaca.markets. DO NOT BUILD trade-updates WebSocket; trigger is BPMN ingress. bars uses per-op baseUrl https://data.alpaca.markets. APCA-API-SECRET-KEY is sent from config api_secret via extraHeaders. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Alpaca. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: account_get | order_create | order_get | order_cancel | position_list | bars | clock | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: symbol
schema.description: Ticker for order_create and bars. Example: AAPL.

schema.label: type
schema.description: order_create type. EXACT: market | limit | stop | stop_limit | trailing_stop.

schema.label: time_in_force
schema.description: order_create time_in_force. EXACT: day | gtc | opg | cls | ioc | fok.

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: Trading API host. Paper: paper-api.alpaca.markets; live: api.alpaca.markets.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: account_get | order_create | order_get | order_cancel | position_list | bars | clock | trigger. Default account_get. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key Id
configurationParameters.description: Alpaca credential (header APCA-API-KEY-ID). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Api Secret
configurationParameters.description: APCA-API-SECRET-KEY. Sent via extraHeaders on every request together with APCA-API-KEY-ID.
